keyPoints: Ghatank (exponent) batata hai aadhar (base) kitni baar guna hoga — 2^4 = 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 16 — yahan 2 aadhar hai aur 4 ghatank.
a^m x a^n = a^(m+n) — aadhar same ho to guna me ghatank judte hain: 3^2 x 3^3 = 3^5.
a^m ÷ a^n = a^(m-n) — bhaag me ghatank ghatte hain: 5^4 ÷ 5^2 = 5^2.
(a^m)^n = a^(m x n) — ghat ki ghat me ghatank guna hote hain: (2^3)^2 = 2^6.
a^0 = 1 (a ≠ 0) — kisi bhi shunya-etar sankhya ki ghat 0 hone par maan 1 hota hai.
Badi sankhyaon ko manak roop me likho: 59,00,000 = 5.9 x 10^6 — 1 se 10 ke beech ki sankhya x 10 ki ghat — isse badi sankhyaen chhoti jagah me likhi jaati hain.
Aam galti: 2^3 ko 2 x 3 = 6 samajhna — ye guna nahi, baar-baar guna hai: 2^3 = 8.
subject: Maths
title: Ghatank aur Ghat
